verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no native Asana whiteboard. Visual whiteboard collaboration is only reachable through third-party tools: an Asana widget for Figma and FigJam (FigJam being the whiteboard) plus live Figma embeds, and a Canva integration for collaborating on designs. Missing for 10: a native shared whiteboard in Asana, documentation of real-time visual co-editing inside Asana, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the whiteboard workflow.
